messages:
alex: Heads up, seeing a spike in fncall rejects for a private customer — looks like a bunch of opaque decode errors from adapters.
mira: Ugh. Which adapter / model variant? link to logs? :eyes:
alex: It's the http-tool-adapter -> actionv2 handler. Root shows "invalid output shape" but the payload is valid JSON, just has extra metadata fields we don't expect.
ian: Can you paste a sample? maybe enum vs object mismatch.
alex: Sure, trimmed snippet:
```
{
  "action": "create_invoice",
  "payload": {"amount": 1250, "currency": "USD"},
  "meta": {"client_ts": 1680000000, "confidence": 0.98}
}
```
Console shows "schema mismatch: expected object Invoice, got extra fields" and the request gets routed to DEGEN and billed as a reject.
mira: The bad part is console doesn't show the mismatched keys, only the error code. Ops can't triage.
ian: That's because our sampling pipeline strips detail for PII reasons, and the console panel doesn't have a preview toggle for sampled payloads.
alex: Right. Customer is complaining about throttling because their integrate suddenly hit soft-rejects and their retry loop got charged.
console-bot: deploy 1798: added a sampling-safe preview flag to staging console -> no PII in preview unless user opts in.
mira: We shouldn't rely on user opt-in for basic diagnostics. Can we tag telemetry with reject_reason and route_id so we can at least aggregate patterns?
ian: We do emit reason in logs but not in our metrics/atlas dimension. Need a lightweight tag: fncall_reject_reason:{enum} and adapter_variant:{string}.
alex: Also want sample of the actual keys that caused rejection (non-sensitive subset) — e.g., list of unexpected top-level fields. That would be super helpful.
mira: Agree. Propose: in sampling pipeline, whitelist structural diffs (field names only), redact values, add field list to telemetry sample. No PII.
ian: Implementation caveat: current sampler collapses JSON to tokens, we'd need a pre-redaction extractor. Small change but safe.
alex: Another weirdness — routing: these rejects are getting routed to the DEGEN model variant which is intended for text fallbacks. That routes to a different quota bucket and inflates billing. Should be routed to a NO-RETRY queue with no charge for the customer.
mira: That is a policy bug. Routing policy currently just checks "reject" flag and fallback mapping; it doesn't differentiate by reject class.
ian: We can update router to consult reject_class dimension (fatal vs structural vs parse) before picking fallback route. Quick patch.
alex: Can we add a console flag in rollouts to soft-validate for 10% of traffic for this customer org? They want better grace before hard reject.
mira: That was my ask — add an org-level soft-validate override in Console Rollouts UI + API. UX small: a toggle + percent slider.
ian: Backend: rollout service already supports targeting by org and percent. Frontend needs UI + API wiring. Workitem ~1d FE + 1d BE + 1d QA.
alex: Telemetry coverage request: add metric invoke.fncall.reject_count with labels {reason, adapter, org, flow_id}. Also emit proto sample for one in 1k rejects to the debug-bucket.
mira: Please ensure proto sample excludes values and long text — only field names and counts.
ian: I'll sketch the change. Plan:
- Add fncall_reject_reason and adapter_variant dims to meter (metric + logs)
- Update sampler to extract unexpected_fields list, redact values
- Router: consult reject_class to avoid billing route for structural rejects
- Console: add soft-validate rollout toggle + preview of sampled field-diffs
- Backfill: run a day of sampling on staging to validate data freshness
alex: Can one of you own coordinating with support/solutions for the customer comms? They saw 400+ rejects last 24h.
mira: I can draft the customer note and internal incident playbook.
ian: I'll open an RFC PR with code pointers and a small migration plan. tagging @frontend-team for UI work.
console-bot: FYI — created task RF-4812 for backend + sampler, task FE-2203 for console toggle.
alex: Thanks. Quick Q: do we want to change billing behavior immediately or wait until rollout completes?
mira: Change router to NO-BILL for structural rejects behind a feature flag, gated by rollout to 100% after 24h observation.
ian: Agreed. I'll make the flag and a canary for a subset of org IDs.
alex: Good. I'll attach the customer logs and link to the support ticket in the RFC.
mira: ping me when PR is ready for review, I'll handle the rollout schedule and the customer message.
ian: PR coming in ~3h. Will include test vectors and a sample redaction extractor.
alex: :thumbsup: Cheers, team. We'll revisit if sampling shows other weird keys.
support-bot: Ticket #INC-12987 updated with current notes and proposed soft-validate rollout plan.
